Name: Camera Tools
Author: Solona
Punchline: Free camera that ReShade add-ons can drive, for accumulation depth of field.
Description:
An untethered free camera for Group Pose that also presents itself to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool. This lets accumulation depth-of-field add-ons -- iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS DoF -- drive the camera to stack frames, along with panorama and multishot capture.

Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support and a compatible depth-of-field add-on.
